Native-safe StatusBadge reproduces the web getStateDefinition('vehicle', status).badgeDot resolution per vehicle FSM state: online -> success default bg-green-400 (#4ade80), driving -> override bg-blue-500 (#3b82f6), charging -> override bg-yellow-400 (#facc15), parked -> override bg-cyan-500 (#06b6d4), updating -> override bg-indigo-500 (#6366f1), asleep -> override bg-purple-500 (#a855f7), offline -> danger default bg-red-400 (#f87171), unknown -> neutral DEFAULT_STATE bg-gray-400 (#9ca3af); the raw status text is capitalized (web CSS `capitalize`), sizes sm/md mirror the web dot/text/gap/padding scale. Native-safe TimeStamp: format 'auto' honours settings.time_format_default (relative default per useTimeFormatPreference), rendering the relative ('just now'/'{n}m/h/d ago', then absolute date past 7d) or absolute ('Apr 4, 2026, 2:30 AM') form; '—' for null/invalid; the web hover Tooltip showing the alternate format is dropped (no native analog). Native-safe AnimatedNumber reproduces the web rAF ease-out-quad (1-(1-p)^2) count-up from 0 over duration*1000ms with tabular-nums, jumping to the final value under OS reduce-motion and cancelling the pending frame on unmount so no timer dangles under --detectOpenHandles. Native-safe WidgetShell covers exactly the props the call site uses (title/icon/loading/updatedAt/isFetching/isStale/isError/onRefresh/children): Skeleton while loading, a titled header (icon + uppercase muted caption title + freshness) or a title-less overlay freshness chip; DataFreshness is a Pressable(onRefresh) status dot+label whose relative time is computed once at render (no 30s interval).

No DOM elements, react-i18next, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, react-dom, or web UI-kit modules are imported into the native output — only React, RN primitives (View/Pressable/StyleSheet/AccessibilityInfo), the shared apps/native AppText/SemanticIcon/tokens, the native parity RadialGauge/EmptyState/Skeleton/WidgetBigNumber, and the native parity useWatchSummary/useWatchComplication/useSettings hooks.
